responsibility: Implements lowering of complex-number operations in GIMPLE into scalar real/imaginary computations. The pass performs SSA-based lattice propagation to discover degenerate complex values, creates and tracks scalar component variables and PHIs, rewrites complex arithmetic/comparisons/conjugation/division into explicit scalar statements, and cleans up EH edges and SSA after expansion so later scalar optimizers and RTL expansion no longer need first-class complex operations.
